The archive shows live Birch board p17/B painted sequence 40 after 41 because req-a was delivered twice (attempts 1 and 2, both grpc-status 0); the accepted service itself still returns source-ordered readings and the Fleet default of three, so the platform's green transport metric and Birch's backward reading are both explicable. The field clock correction overlaps the p17 trace, the training simulator is separate, and p23's missing capture is recorded as an instrumentation gap. A runnable replay reproduces all checks, the final handover and captures are committed, and the 06:10Z proposal (Birch park, Cedar overflow) was dry-run as feasible with production approval unissued. No traffic or production change was made; that remains with the release owner.

input.title: Fleet overnight handover: green RPCs, suppressed stale retry, p23 instrumentation gap
input.body: Final handover is committed under handover/. Evidence reconciliation: older B-12/relay-9 aliases resolve to Birch current training/live assignments, not Cedar. Ingress saw Birch feed B sequence 40, then 41, then a duplicate retry of 40; live panel p17 painted 40 then 41 and suppressed the stale retry, so no observed live regression on p17. Training panel p71 painted sequence 39 and is not live. Live panel p23 has no terminal capture (instrumentation gap); the B-12 field note converts to about 22:02:26-22:03:50Z but cannot identify p17 versus the adjacent simulator. All ingress attempts returned grpc_status 0, and bench/check.mjs only sums grpc_error, so "delivery green" does not prove display freshness. The replay is handover/replay.mjs and currently passes. The dry-run proposal (06:10Z, Birch park, Cedar overflow) booked feasible with productionApproval unissued. No service, protocol, route, or traffic change was made; production remains with the release owner.

Live Birch p23 remains unobserved because its terminal capture is missing, and the B-12 field note cannot identify p17 versus the adjacent simulator. The next shift has a committed diagnosis, exact evidence, a passing runnable replay, and a feasible dry-run booking proposal (06:10Z, Birch park, Cedar overflow). Production approval remains unissued and no traffic or service change was made.
